title: Check other Payload queries for unnecessary depth settings
body: Search the codebase for other `depth: [12]` usages in Payload find/get calls, especially in API endpoints. depth:2 causes recursive population that can silently add seconds to query times. Verify each usage actually needs the populated data vs. plain IDs.
rationale: The get-conversation.ts fix was found by inspection. Other endpoints may have the same pattern. A sweep could prevent similar performance issues elsewhere.
